cases.message: Three production streams deliver A=126 stb/d, B=94 stb/d, and C=57 stb/d. Give the combined total rate.
An injection rate fell from 872 to 713 stb/d. Calculate its percentage decrease.
Gas 3120 scf and oil 104 stb were collected. Calculate the gas-to-oil ratio.
A tank received 648 bbl over 12 hours. Give bbl/day.
Pressure starts at 3330 psi, falls to 3070 psi, recovers to 3210 psi. Calculate drawdown and recovery.
Mix 65 bbl at 9.2 ppg, 95 bbl at 10.1 ppg, and 40 bbl at 10.9 ppg. Calculate weighted average density.
A=19 psi and B=8 psi. Using my equation R = A - B, calculate R.
x=7 dimensionless, y=3 dimensionless. My relation is Z = x * y + 2. Calculate Z.
P=6 kW, t=4 h. Use my equation E = P * t and compute E.
a=14 m, b=5 m. I define L = a + b. Calculate L using that equation.
For crude oil with SG=0.876, locate the specific-gravity to API equation in the internal textbook and calculate API gravity.
Using the internal Formation Evaluation relation for formation factor F, calculate F when phi=0.17, a=1, and m=2. Cite the literal equation.
Find the internal Production Technology II equation defining P1 from PR and Pwfs. Calculate P1 for PR=2870 psi and Pwfs=2560 psi.
Locate the internal Well Test Analysis relation for superficial velocity u from flow rate q and cross-sectional area A. Compute u for q=18 m3/s and A=6 m2 using that sourced relation.
A second oil sample has SG=0.945. Retrieve the textbook API-gravity relation and calculate its API gravity with source provenance.
From the internal Formation Evaluation formation-factor equation, compute F for phi=0.25, a=1 and m=2; verify the source span.
From the internal drilling material, explain why a nonmagnetic drill collar is placed around magnetic survey instruments. Include a source citation.
According to the internal reservoir engineering material, explain the distinction between free-water level and an observed oil-water contact. Cite the evidence.
A=68 stb/d, B=135 stb/d, C=97 stb/d. Calculate both the total and the arithmetic mean, then rank the streams by rate.
A=45 psi, B=71 psi, C=52 psi. Report both the average pressure and the highest labeled case.

resume_probes.message: Find the internal API-gravity conversion relation and calculate API gravity for my oil sample; I will provide SG after you ask.
Use the internal Formation Evaluation equation to calculate formation factor F with a=1 and m=2. Ask me only if a necessary input remains.
Find the internal P1 = PR - Pwfs relation and calculate P1 when PR=3010 psi. I can supply any missing pressure.
A=36 psi. Calculate the difference A-B, and ask only for an absent operand.
